Targeted Focal Indicator Analysis and Plotting around House Buffers

Source: R/indices_buffer.R
d4h_indicator_buffer.Rd

Drastically accelerates computational efficiency and saves memory by cropping, calculating micro-environmental/epidemiological indicators, and plotting exclusively within a defined buffer zone (measured in grid-units or meters) around residential houses from a CSV or spatial layer.

Usage

d4h_indicator_buffer(
  indicator = "NDVI",
  houses,
  radius = 3,
  cell_size = 50,
  radius_in_meters = FALSE,
  nir = NULL,
  red = NULL,
  green = NULL,
  blue = NULL,
  red_edge = NULL,
  dem = NULL,
  lst = NULL,
  raster_in = NULL,
  square = TRUE,
  mask_outside = TRUE,
  house_color = "red",
  house_size = 2.5,
  palette = "viridis",
  limits = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  plot = TRUE
)

Arguments

indicator

Character or Function. Name of the index or function to compute. Supported character names: "NDVI", "NDWI", "SAVI", "DVI", "GNDVI", "NDRE", "EVI", "VARI", "TVI", "MSAVI2", "IRHE", "IMSR", "IRTS", "slope", "twi", "dsm", "rgb". Alternatively, pass a custom function function(...) or a pre-calculated SpatRaster.

houses

Character path, data.frame, SpatVector, or sf object containing house coordinates (e.g., CSV with lon/lat or x/y columns).

radius

Numeric. Buffer radius surrounding each house. Defined in number of grid cells (default: 3). If radius_in_meters = TRUE, interpreted directly as meters.

cell_size

Numeric. Grid cell size in meters used to establish grid scale and calculate buffer distances (default: 50).

radius_in_meters

Logical. If FALSE (default), total buffer distance is radius * cell_size. If TRUE, total buffer distance is radius.

nir

SpatRaster or character path. Near-Infrared band (optional, required for multispectral indices).

red

SpatRaster or character path. Red band (optional).

green

SpatRaster or character path. Green band (optional).

blue

SpatRaster or character path. Blue band (optional).

red_edge

SpatRaster or character path. Red Edge band (optional).

dem

SpatRaster or character path. DEM / DSM raster (optional).

lst

SpatRaster or character path. Land Surface Temperature raster (optional).

raster_in

SpatRaster or character path (optional). Directly provides an already computed raster or pre-stacked imagery to crop and plot.

square

Logical. If TRUE, creates square grid cells; if FALSE, hexagonal grid cells (default: TRUE).

mask_outside

Logical. If TRUE (default), masks pixel values outside the house buffer polygons to NA. If FALSE, retains unmasked rectangular cropped extent.

house_color

Character. Color for house points on the plot (default: "red").

house_size

Numeric. Size for house points on the plot (default: 2.5).

palette

Character. Color palette name ("viridis", "magma", "terrain", "spectral") or custom color vector (default: "viridis").

limits

Numeric vector c(min, max) to fix color scale limits (default: NULL).

title

Character. Custom plot title (optional).

plot

Logical. If TRUE (default), returns a list with the raster, grid summary, and ggplot. If FALSE, skips rendering.

Value

A list containing:

  • raster: The targeted cropped SpatRaster of the computed indicator.

  • houses: An sf object of the houses intersecting the scene.

  • buffer: An sf polygon of the focal buffer envelope.

  • grid: An sf / SpatVector zonal grid summary within the buffer zone.

  • plot: A ggplot object visualizing the buffer zone, raster indicator, and house points (if plot = TRUE).

Details

In ultra-high resolution drone mapping (100M+ pixels), calculating continuous indices over the entire scene consumes unnecessary computational resources. d4h_indicator_buffer creates an operational envelope around houses: $$\text{Buffer Distance} = R \times \text{cell\_size}$$ It crops the raw band inputs strictly to the bounding box of intersecting buffer zones, masks non-focal areas, computes the specified spectral/terrain/epidemiological index, extracts grid summaries, and produces an publication-ready ggplot visualization with house points overlaid.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (interactive()) {
  library(drones4health)
  library(terra)
  library(sf)

  # Define paths to bands and house locations
  nir_path   <- system.file("extdata", "nir.tif", package = "drones4health")
  red_path   <- system.file("extdata", "red.tif", package = "drones4health")
  houses_csv <- system.file("extdata", "houses.csv", package = "drones4health")

  # Run focal buffer analysis around houses (150m buffer)
  res_buffer <- d4h_indicator_buffer(
    indicator = "NDVI",
    houses    = houses_csv,
    radius    = 3,
    cell_size = 50,
    nir       = nir_path,
    red       = red_path,
    palette   = "viridis"
  )
  head(res_buffer$grid)
}
# }
